title: SandpaneChangeSet
description: git.review result: the ACTUAL change set versus the task's recorded base revision, including untracked files (specs/06 §6, specs/08 T15). Never a mocked-up diff. A5 adds the optional repoPath, uninspected and changes[].oldPath (design 2026-10-09 §3.5 item 2). A6 adds the optional reviewId, hostHooksPath and changes[].taskBlob/taskMode (§3.6 items 3 and 9); git.apply entries are changes[] items copied verbatim.

baseCommit.description: Recorded base revision the task started from.

hostDirty.description: True when the host working tree has uncommitted changes at review time.

repoPath.description: A5 (additive, optional): the canonical host repository root of the task - the integration target hostDirty describes.

uninspected.description: A5 (additive, optional): paths Core could not inspect. Defined but never produced in A5: a repository with submodules is still refused with VALIDATION_FAILED, never returned as a partial list.

reviewId.description: A6 (additive, optional; design 2026-10-09 §3.6 item 3, R4): an opaque id for this answer, set only for host_worktree tasks. Core keeps the last 8 per task in memory (a Core restart means review again). git.apply accepts only entries copied verbatim from a review Core produced. Not a human-presence token.

hostHooksPath.description: A6 (additive, optional; §3.6 item 9): the host repository's effective core.hooksPath, reported only when it is repo-relative (in repo-relative form). Clients flag applied paths under it as running automatically.

path.description: Exactly as git reports it (NUL-separated since A5, never C-quoted). git.diff accepts only this exact string.

oldPath.description: A5 (additive, optional): the pre-rename path; set only for status renamed.

taskBlob.description: A6 (additive, optional; §3.6 item 3): git blob id of the task-side bytes Core itself read (SHA-1 with collision detection, or SHA-256, per the repository's object format). host_worktree only; absent for deleted entries, files over the 32 MiB apply cap (too large to apply) and entries Core could not read as a file or symlink.

taskMode.description: A6 (additive, optional): 100644, 100755 or 120000 from lstat of the task-side entry; present exactly when taskBlob is. An open string, not an enum.
